answer_1.quote: We treat RE as a conditional text generation task. Concretely, for a dataset of size N, we model the probability of generating a linearized string y of a relation triplet ... conditioned on a context string C.
answer_1.outputs: Linearized relation triplets/pairs (e.g., [(drug, adverse effect), ...] or [(subject, relation, object)])

answer_2.quote: We report micro-F1 scores ... Table 2 shows comparison of (micro-F1) performance ...

answer_4.quote: We hired human annotators on Amazon Mechanical Turk to manually re-assess all ostensible FPs and FNs from each of our datasets. ... we provided annotators with the input text ... and ask the question: "Can the given relation be reasonably derived from the text?"
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked whether a generated relation could be reasonably inferred from the text (for false positives) and whether a reference relation could be inferred from the generated set (for false negatives).
